stats.compositionTitle: How they relate to other members
stats.compositionDesc: Each slice shows how many members in the tree fall into each relation type.
stats.personDesc: The starting point of this statistic.
stats.ancestorsDesc: Parents, grandparents and their forebears, on the ascending line.
stats.descendantsDesc: Children, grandchildren and their descendants, on the descending line.
stats.siblingsDesc: People sharing at least one parent.
stats.partnersDesc: People directly linked through a partnership.
stats.othersDesc: The rest of the tree's members, without a direct link (e.g. in-laws, partners' relatives).
stats.generationDesc: Each slice is a generation — G1 is the oldest known one. The intense purple slice, marked "*", is the current generation.
stats.generationCurrentDesc: The generation this person belongs to.
stats.longevityDetail: {{age}} years — the longest life recorded in the tree so far
stats.timelineDesc: Each bar shows the lifespan of a close relative. The purple outline marks this person, and a hollow circle at the bar's end means they're still alive.
stats.timelineEmpty: Add birth dates to close relatives to see the family timeline.
stats.generationAgeDesc: Average age (at death, or current age for the living) for each generation in the tree.
stats.generationAgeEmpty: Not enough age data across multiple generations yet.
stats.birthMonthDesc: How many tree members were born in each month of the year. The highlighted bar shows this person's birth month.
stats.birthMonthEmpty: Add birth dates to see which months your family was born in.

landing.heroSubtitle: Add grandparents, parents, children — with photos and stories — and watch your whole family come to life in a family tree you can build in minutes, not weekends.
landing.heroFootnote: No subscription. No card at sign-up. You can optionally support the project with a donation.
landing.agitateTitle: How many of your family's stories are already lost?
landing.agitateBody: Photos forgotten on old phones. The names of great-grandparents no one remembers anymore. Stories only your grandmother still knows — and that no one has written down anywhere. With every generation that passes, a piece of your family's history disappears forever.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to save your family's history
landing.featuresSubtitle: No learning curve. No technical hassle.
landing.feature1Desc: Name, photo, birth date — and link them to the family with a simple click. No tutorial needed.
landing.feature2Desc: See entire generations at a glance, with drag & drop for quick reorganizing.
landing.feature3Desc: Every member has their own page with a biography, like a short article about their life.
landing.feature4Desc: Photos are uploaded and secured automatically — they're never lost.
landing.feature5Desc: Not just parent-child — link partnerships too, as well as connections between families.
landing.feature6Desc: From your phone or laptop, your family tree is always one click away.
landing.howTitle: Three steps. A few minutes. Done.
landing.step1Desc: No card, no commitment. Just email and password.
landing.step2Desc: You, your parents, your grandparents — then gradually expand to the rest of the family.
landing.step3Title: Watch your family come to life
landing.step3Desc: The tree builds itself, visually, as you add connections.
landing.socialProofLabel: People already preserving their family's story
landing.testimonial1: I managed to gather in two evenings all the history my grandmother had been telling me for years. Now it won't be lost.
landing.testimonial2: I discovered relatives I knew nothing about, just by rebuilding the tree with my parents.
landing.testimonial3: The interface is so simple that even my 78-year-old grandfather managed to add his own photo.
landing.supportTitle: We don't sell subscriptions. We don't lock features.
landing.supportBody: eArbore is free for everyone, forever. Servers, photo storage, and ongoing development cost money — if the platform helps you, a donation (however small) keeps us online for one more family.
landing.donateTier1Impact: Supports the servers for a day
landing.donateTier3Impact: Keeps the platform online for a month
landing.faq1Q: Is it really free, with no hidden costs?
landing.faq1A: Yes. We don't ask for a card at sign-up and we don't lock features behind a subscription. Donations are 100% optional.
landing.faq2Q: What happens to my family's photos and data?
landing.faq2A: They're stored securely and are never sold or shared with third parties. Your tree is private, visible only to you.
landing.faq3A: Yes, you can mark a member as deceased and keep their story, photos, and data — just like any other member.
landing.faq4Q: How big can the tree get?
landing.faq4A: There's no artificial limit — you can add as many generations and relatives as you need.
landing.finalCtaTitle: Start today. Your family deserves to be remembered.
landing.finalCtaSubtitle: No card. No subscription. Ready in under a minute.
